thread:
Sam (CSM): Quick ask from QuantaSense - they're cutting over beta traffic to Sao Paulo cluster tomorrow 08:30 BRT and want temporary per-route QPS increases + an IP allowlist for their egress. Can we approve a short window and autoscale rules?
Rui (QuantaSense): Hi all, yes. Routes are /v2/predict (current 150 qps) -> 900 qps and /v2/healthcheck (50 qps) -> 300 qps for 5 hours. Source IPs: 52.10.128.0/22 and 52.10.132.0/22. We'll send traceroute shortly. Also renewal touchpoint next month - want no throttles during this demo.
Lina (NetEng): Per-route overrides are fine. We prefer tagging windows as "customer-temp" + customer name for auditing. Two quick Qs: 1) Is this hosted-only traffic? 2) Do you need regional routing pinned to sa-east-1?
Rui (QuantaSense): Hosted-only. Yes please pin to sa-east-1 for lower RTT.
Sam (CSM): Please also add autorevoke at 13:30 UTC (08:30 BRT -> 13:30 UTC). Auto-revoke and an immediate rollback trigger if 5xx >1% for 5m.
Marcus (Oncall): I'll add monitoring hooks. Suggested alerts: 5xx > 1% sustained 5m, P95 > 900ms sustained 5m, token-cost spike > 25% over baseline. If triggered we'll rollback and post incident note here.
Lina (NetEng): I started a staging rollout and ran smoke tests. Command I used in staging: 
```
redwoodctl rate-window create --name qs-brazil-window-3350 \
  --cidrs 52.10.128.0/22,52.10.132.0/22 \
  --routes /v2/predict=900,/v2/healthcheck=300 \
  --region sa-east-1 --start 2026-03-25T08:30:00-03:00 --end 2026-03-25T13:30:00Z \
  --tags customer-temp,quantasense,autorevoke
```
Staging sanity: /v2/predict handled burst of 1.2k rps for 30s in staging with stable 200ms p95.
peering-bot: peering-bot: Initiated peering pre-check for QuantaSense. Waiting for traceroute + ASN. Known good: no inbound RSTs from sa-east edge during staging.
notes: Lina will promote to prod at 2026-03-25T11:30:00Z after confirming traceroute. Marcus has rollback command ready. Sam will schedule renewal touchpoint post-launch. Ticket INF-3498 created.
